都弄完后，王野和王笑笑一人拿着一个瓶子，来到了院子里。秦婉，李婶和刘婶又继续了刚才的聊天，只是这次聊天的内容多了王野这个主人公。

小丫头也是个狗窝里藏不住粮的主儿，刚一出来就小跑着去找秦婉显摆了：“娘～大锅给，香。”

秦婉看着王笑笑手里的木瓶，在围裙上擦了一下手，一把就给抢了过来。反复打量了一会儿，打开盖子闻了一下。小丫头见秦婉抢了自己的好吃的，回头看着王野，小嘴儿一撅就要哭了。

王野上前一把抱起了小丫头，挂着她的鼻子：“该，让你显摆。”

秦婉指着王野笑骂道：“你就是闲的，谁家这么惯着孩子呀，这么好的一个瓶子你就给她装零嘴了。再说了，你出门看看谁家孩子有零嘴呀？”

王野前世一个孤儿，既没有弟妹，也没有子女，在他眼里把所有好东西都给弟弟妹妹就是爱他们。不论吃喝，还是玩具他都要想着办法给弟弟妹妹，尤其是这个可爱的小妹妹。

他的有太多的求不得，他不想妹妹也有遗憾。但是王野忽略了时代的局限性，大多数家庭的孩子大部分都是老天爷养的。给口饭吃，不让冻着就已经拼尽了父母的全力了。

这次出门回来后，王野也想过这个问题。以后吃，喝，玩上还是不会委屈弟弟妹妹的，但是也不会没有下限的宠溺了，该教的规矩还是要教的。

王野听着秦婉的笑骂：“娘～这不是丫头还小吗，总不能让她吃坚果呀，再说了这么个小瓶是我自己弄的，又不费劲儿。”

王野边解释边不动声色的从秦婉手中，拿过王笑笑的小瓶子。拿了瓶子王野就抱着王笑笑坐在了门口的台阶上，离秦婉远一点儿。

秦婉白了王野一眼，叹了口气继续洗衣服。李婶看着秦婉的样子：“嫂子，就这你还不知足呀，你看看我家，一天天的鸡飞狗跳的。”

秦婉：“咳～，是该知足，你也看到了，这丫头现在都有点学会熊人了，他大哥不在家的时候让怎么样就怎样，你看看这才刚回来好像有了仗势一样，这长大了还了得。”

李婶安慰道：“嫂子，这不是笑笑还小吗，你看小野有这么惯着你家老二吗，等这丫头大点儿了小野会教导的。”

秦婉：“但愿吧，现在这臭小子越来越大了，我是越来越管不了了。妹子，你说我是不是老了，看着小野越懂事儿，我就越觉得自己老了。”

刘婶插话调笑道：“嫂子，你可不老，这要是和王哥努力努力再给小野添个弟弟妹妹也没问题。”

秦婉白了刘婶一眼：“瞎说什么呢，当着孩子呢。”

刘婶继续道：“呦～呦～，听这意思是不当着孩子就能说了，看这意思是真想要呀？”

三个中年妇女就在那里边忙活，边开着玩笑。王野就在台阶上静静的坐着，小丫头则在王野怀里腻歪着，一会儿张嘴要口坚果粉。时间很快到了五点多钟，就在秦婉要去做饭时王野拦住她，自己进了厨房。

在李婶和刘婶羡慕的目光中，秦婉会心一笑，既有欣慰也有显摆的意思。王野在厨房里忙碌着，门槛儿上还坐着个小监工。

在王铁柱和赵爷爷回来时正好王野做的饭也出锅了，一大锅的飞龙炖榛蘑，用的当然是拿回来的风干的飞龙。虽然味道不如现杀的鲜嫩，但是也有不一样的口感。

王野端着一盆菜，后面还跟着个小尾巴。一进门王铁柱看见大儿子，眼里露出了惊喜，关切，担心但是嘴上却只有一句话：“回来啦？”

After everything was done, Wang Ye and Wang Xiaoxiao came to the yard each holding a bottle.Qin Wan, Aunt Li and Aunt Liu continued their previous chat, but this time the chat included the protagonist Wang Ye.

The little girl is also a master who can't hide food in the kennel. As soon as she came out, she ran to Qin Wan to show off: "Mom, give me a big pot, it smells delicious."

Qin Wan looked at the wooden bottle in Wang Xiaoxiao's hand, wiped her hands on her apron, and snatched it away.After looking at it for a while, I opened the lid and smelled it.When the little girl saw Qin Wan snatching her delicious food, she turned back to look at Wang Ye, her little mouth pouted and she was about to cry.

Wang Ye stepped forward and picked up the little girl, holding her by the nose: "Okay, let you show off."

Qin Wan pointed at Wang Ye and scolded with a smile: "You are just idle. Who is so spoiled to their children? Why don't you give her snacks in such a good bottle? Besides, why don't you go out and see whose children have snacks?"

Wang Ye was an orphan in his previous life. He had neither siblings nor children. In his eyes, giving all good things to his siblings meant loving them.Whether it's food, drink, or toys, he has to think of ways to give it to his younger siblings, especially this cute little sister.

He had too many things he couldn't ask for, and he didn't want his sister to have regrets.But Wang Ye ignored the limitations of the times. Most of the children in most families were raised by God.It took all the parents' efforts to give him food to eat and not let him freeze.

After returning from this trip, Wang Ye also thought about this issue.In the future, when it comes to eating, drinking, and playing, they will not wrong their younger siblings, but they will not be pampered without limit. The rules that should be taught still need to be taught.

Wang Ye listened to Qin Wan's laughter and scolding: "Mom, isn't this girl still young? We can't let her eat nuts. Besides, I made such a small bottle myself, and it didn't take any effort."

Wang Ye explained while calmly taking Wang Xiaoxiao's small bottle from Qin Wan's hand.After taking the bottle, Wang Ye hugged Wang Xiaoxiao and sat on the steps at the door, far away from Qin Wan.

Qin Wan rolled her eyes at Wang Ye, sighed and continued to wash clothes.Aunt Li looked at Qin Wan: "Sister-in-law, you're not satisfied with this. Look at my house, it's going crazy day by day."

Qin Wan: "Ahem~ It's time to be content. As you can see, this girl has learned to be a bear now. When her elder brother is not at home, she can do whatever she wants. Look at her, she seems to have gained strength when she just came back. It will be better when she grows up."

Aunt Li comforted her: "Sister-in-law, isn't Xiaoxiao still a little girl? Do you think Xiaoye is so doting on your second child? Xiaoye will teach this girl when she gets older."

Qin Wan: "I hope so. Now this brat is getting bigger and bigger, and I can't control him anymore. Sister, do you think I'm getting old? The more sensible Xiaoye becomes, the older I feel."

Aunt Liu interjected and joked: "Sister-in-law, you are not old. If you and Brother Wang work hard, there will be no problem in adding a younger brother and sister to Xiaoye."

Qin Wan rolled her eyes at Aunt Liu: "What nonsense are you talking about, in front of a child."

Aunt Liu continued: "Yo~ yo~, this means you can say it without being in front of the child. Does this mean you really want it?"

Three middle-aged women were working there and joking.Wang Ye sat quietly on the steps, while the little girl leaned in Wang Ye's arms and opened her mouth to take a bite of nut powder.The time soon reached five o'clock, and just when Qin Wan was about to cook, Wang Ye stopped her and entered the kitchen.

Under the envious looks of Aunt Li and Aunt Liu, Qin Wan smiled knowingly, which was both gratifying and showing off.Wang Ye was busy in the kitchen, and there was a small supervisor sitting on the threshold.

When Wang Tiezhu and Grandpa Zhao came back, the rice cooked by Wang Ye was also coming out. A large pot of Feilong stewed hazel mushrooms, using the dried Feilong they brought back.Although the taste is not as fresh and tender as freshly killed, it also has a different texture.

Wang Ye was carrying a bowl of vegetables, followed by a little tail.As soon as Wang Tiezhu saw his eldest son after entering the door, his eyes showed surprise, concern, and worry, but there was only one sentence on his lips: "You're back?"
